subject: Request: small engagement onboarding — PO exemption needed for trial
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@microvendor.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding request — small-ticket trial, no PO?

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — MicroVendor is excited to run a short pilot integrating Redwood for our in-app prompts. This will be a 6-week, low-dollar trial (estimated invoices ~$1.2K total).

Our procurement is fairly lightweight for pilots; we typically do invoice-only for engagements under $5K. Can you confirm if Redwood can accept this onboarding without a PO? If Redwood requires a PO, we can route it but it will delay start by 2–3 weeks.

I attached our vendor intake and W-9 for your records (microvendor_vendor_intake.pdf, microvendor_w9.pdf).

We'd like to start next Monday 6/14 if possible. Please advise next steps and any paperwork we should complete.

Cheers,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Integrations
MicroVendor Inc

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Onboarding request — small-ticket trial, no PO?

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the intake and for the clear timeline. Looping in Karthik (procurement) and Marissa (finance ops) to confirm the path.

Quick context for you and our team: Redwood's standard policy is PO-required for active vendors, but we have an "invoice-only" provisional track for pilots under $5K with the following guardrails:
- Vendor intake + W-9 on file
- Minimal contractual addendum (procurement-approved)
- Invoice terms: Net 30
- Trial capped at $5K and single invoice per month

Karthik / Marissa: Can we provisionally approve MicroVendor for invoice-only onboarding for this trial? Their intake is attached to their original message. If yes, we'll send a one-page addendum to Elena and ask for a billing contact. If not, please advise exact missing pieces.

Elena — I can send the addendum today and mark the trial start for 6/14 once procurement signs off.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0184
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding request — small-ticket trial, no PO?

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the intake and the W-9. Risk scoring: LOW-MED (startup vendor, minimal data access, trial-only API keys).

Procurement is comfortable with a temporary invoice-only workflow for this one-off pilot under the following conditions:
1) Signed one-page addendum that limits exposure to the trial scope and fees (I drafted a one-pager and uploaded to Drive).
2) Single invoice per month, Net 30 terms.
3) MicroVendor must not store Redwood customer data or request privileged entitlements during the trial.
4) Finance needs a billing contact and PO preference noted in HubSpot (even if PO will not be used).

Sofia / Marissa: If you confirm those controls are in place, procurement will approve the exception. I'll mark the vendor as "Invoice-only provisional" in our vendor registry and tag the HubSpot deal (link below).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67291
Draft addendum: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Procurement/MicroVendor/Intake

Karthik
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
